data.summary: E081 experiment: view-count principle on laboratory instrument error codes. Key results: G1 PASS (35≥30 both arms), G2 FAIL (0.70 accuracy vs 0.85 threshold, rubric misalignment), G3 REPORTING: treatment 60.0% served (21/35), 0% partially_served; control 57.1% served (20/35), 31.4% partially_served. Key finding: view-count principle generalizes to laboratory instrument error codes with domain-differentiated pattern (binary served/unserved vs mixed partials). Decision: hold - principle not limited to software/Q&A domains, narrows viable candidate space. Fresh observation confirmed in new domain per D083.
